mapper.insert: /* QuoteMapper.insertQuote */ INSERT INTO QUOTE (SVC_REQ_SN, USR_SN, QUT_AMT, QUT_CN, QUT_STATUS_CD, QUT_REVISE_CNT, QUT_REG_ID, QUT_UPDT_ID) VALUES (#{svcReqSn}, #{usrSn}, #{qutAmt}, #{qutCn}, #{qutStatusCd}, 0, #{qutRegId}, #{qutUpdtId})

/* QuoteMapper.insertQuoteHistory */ INSERT INTO QUOTE_HISTORY (QUT_SN, QUT_HST_AMT, QUT_HST_CN, QUT_HST_REG_ID, QUT_HST_UPDT_ID) VALUES (#{qutSn}, #{qutHstAmt}, #{qutHstCn}, #{qutHstRegId}, #{qutHstUpdtId})
mapper.select: /* QuoteMapper.findQuotesBySvcReqSn */ SELECT q.QUT_SN, q.USR_SN AS PROVIDER_USR_SN, u.USR_NM AS PROVIDER_NM, q.QUT_AMT, q.QUT_CN, q.QUT_STATUS_CD, q.QUT_REVISE_CNT, q.QUT_REG_DT, q.QUT_UPDT_DT FROM QUOTE q JOIN USERS u ON u.USR_SN = q.USR_SN WHERE q.SVC_REQ_SN = #{svcReqSn} ORDER BY q.QUT_REG_DT DESC
